title: channels.yaml
description: Configured origins of sources (10-design §8, §5.1). Concept groups carry a `techniques:` mapping — the coverage-topic <-> taxonomy join that absence claims need.

additionalProperties.description: Named breadth preset; shape is channel-family specific.

ai_context.description: AI-context surface forms ORed into a disjunction and ANDed onto every `misuse: true` concept group on phrase-match channels (v1 search_config.yaml `ai_context`). Read by collect.semantic_scholar. Token-AND backends (OpenAlex) cannot express the intersection and skip the misuse groups instead, so this list is what makes the misuse axis collectable at all.

channel_groups.description: Identity groups (store design §6): per group, the key kinds that merge documents within it. Keys are the channel_group words.

institutions.description: OpenAlex institution-id sweep targets for collect.openalex (v1 orgs.yaml `openalex_institutions`). One entry per curated institution id; NEVER auto-adopted (OpenAlex name search misresolves).

broad.description: common-token group needing a field filter on token-AND APIs

misuse.description: dangerous-capability terms ANDed with an AI-context term

needs_ai_context.description: broad terms ('decision theory', 'game theory') only meaningful ANDed with the `ai_context` disjunction: collect.semantic_scholar and the arXiv keyword family intersect them; collect.openalex sends a boolean phrase query (docs/scope/shallow-review.md (d) E1/E2)

techniques.description: Taxonomy technique slugs this group maps to (the join absence claims need).

openalex_terms.description: REPLACES `terms` on OpenAlex only (v1 search_config parity). Needed when a phrase is fine under phrase-matching but floods OpenAlex's token-AND search — 'sparse autoencoder' token-ANDs to any paper with 'sparse' AND 'autoencoder'. An EMPTY list means the group has no OpenAlex-viable term and is skipped there entirely.

s2_terms.description: REPLACES `terms` on Semantic Scholar only (collect.semantic_scholar), as `openalex_terms` does on OpenAlex: S2's bulk search stems a quoted word ('steerability' matches 'steer'). An EMPTY list skips the group there; the phrase-match channels (arXiv `ti:`/`abs:`, forums) keep `terms`.

forum_terms.description: REPLACES `terms` on the forum search only (collect.forums: LessWrong, Alignment Forum): their search is not a phrase match, so a common phrase returns most of the forum. An EMPTY list asks nothing for the group there.

kind.description: The channel kinds (10-design glossary/§8); `feed` = an RSS/Atom feed read by collect.feeds, one channel per feed (round 4, track L).

location.description: API endpoint, site root, or drop directory.

license_class.description: Default license class stamped on this channel's sources; validated against enums.license_class.

concept_groups.description: Which concept groups this channel runs: the string 'all' or an explicit list of group ids.

mailto.description: polite-pool contact, or 'env' to read from environment

self_published_org.description: org slug when publisher == subject org (mechanically known)

channel_group.description: Identity group of this channel's sources (store design §6); keys merge only within a group.

miss_means.description: What a provider-side miss means (D13): withdrawn = miss_cap consecutive misses retract the source; unknown (default) never withdraws.

non_merging_keys.description: Key kinds recorded on this channel's sources that never merge identities (related, relay, the X context keys); vocabulary linted by tools/check_configs.py.

record_projection.description: Ordered stable record fields hashed into sources.record_digest (C23; counters excluded). Empty or absent = the collector's default.

include_re.description: kind: feed only: a Python regex an item's link (as the feed spells it) must match (re.search); absent = every item.

keyword_cuts.description: OpenAlex / Semantic Scholar: the backfill cuts (2026-10-13, docs/design/collection-yield.md §10) on concept-group hits; institution and author-id queries are never cut. Classifier and vocabularies: stack/rules.py keyword_cut.

drop_sources.description: publisher = a publisher DOI or no DOI and no arXiv location; self_publication = Zenodo and preprint-server DOIs (SSRN kept).

ai_term_groups.description: Concept groups whose hits are kept only with an AI term (stack/rules.py AI_TERMS) in title or abstract.

publisher_cut_floor.description: D654 (a): a hit published before this date whose title or abstract carries a pre-2020 safety stem (stack/rules.py PRE2020_SAFETY_STEMS) bypasses drop_sources; ai_term still applies. In the group's coverage key with the stem set's digest.

field_filter_floor.description: D654 (b), OpenAlex: each field_filter_groups group is swept once more up to the day before this date without the CS-field filter, as a second plan entry with its own coverage key (D671). Requires field_filter_groups.

field_filter_groups.description: Broad concept groups (broad: true) the field_filter_floor applies to. Requires field_filter_floor.

venue_ai_term.description: With keep_venues: the allowlist keeps only a hit with an AI term in title or abstract (stack/rules.py venue_allowlist_applies); a venue hit without one is a publisher work. The AI-term vocabulary's digest is in the group's coverage key.

keep_venues.description: the Chinese-coverage work: the publisher cut keeps hits with a DOI of an allowlisted venue (stack/rules.py VENUE_DOI_PREFIXES: ACL Anthology, AAAI, IJCAI, NDSS, PLOS). The allowlist's digest is in the coverage key of every group the publisher cut applies to.

org.description: kebab org slug; surfaced on coverage receipts as `org:<slug>`

fields.description: primary_topic.field.id volume guard (v1 openalex_fields); set only on generic big-company entities. 17=CS, 33=Social Sci, 18=Decision Sci, 32=Psychology, 26=Mathematics.
